source: Tenet/EBS description processing priority: FLUSH -> NMFC / ITEM -> CLASS -> R LINE -> RDG. Nothing is invented; insufficient source information produces VERIFY.
rule: If the description contains an NMFC item number and a class, they may be entered together. If either is missing, mark VERIFY / INSUFFICIENT INFORMATION. NEVER convert an NMFC value into an MM handling-unit entry. NEVER invent FLUSH, NMFC, CLASS, R-LINE or RDG values.
